changeSet.sql: UPDATE result SET correction_round = ranked.new_round FROM (SELECT r.id, COALESCE(taken.max_round, -1) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.submission_id ORDER BY r.id) AS new_round FROM result r LEFT JOIN (SELECT submission_id, MAX(correction_round) AS max_round FROM result WHERE submission_id IS NOT NULL AND assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC') GROUP BY submission_id) taken ON taken.submission_id = r.submission_id WHERE r.submission_id IS NOT NULL AND r.correction_round IS NULL AND r.assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC')) AS ranked WHERE result.id = ranked.id

UPDATE result JOIN (SELECT r.id, COALESCE(taken.max_round, -1) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.submission_id ORDER BY r.id) AS new_round FROM result r LEFT JOIN (SELECT submission_id, MAX(correction_round) AS max_round FROM result WHERE submission_id IS NOT NULL AND assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC') GROUP BY submission_id) taken ON taken.submission_id = r.submission_id WHERE r.submission_id IS NOT NULL AND r.correction_round IS NULL AND r.assessment_type IN ('MANUAL', 'SEMI_AUTOMATIC')) AS ranked ON result.id = ranked.id SET result.correction_round = ranked.new_round
